-- Copyright (c) 2025 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.

module Intro.Asset where

data SplitResult = SplitResult with
  splitAsset : ContractId Asset
  remainder : ContractId Asset
    deriving (Eq, Show)

-- ASSET_BEGIN
template Asset
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
    symbol : Text
    quantity : Decimal
    observers : [Party]
  where
    signatory issuer, owner
    ensure quantity > 0.0

    observer observers
-- ASSET_END


-- MERGE_SPLIT_BEGIN
    choice Split
      : SplitResult
      with
        splitQuantity : Decimal
      controller owner
      do
        splitAsset <- create this with
          quantity = splitQuantity
        remainder <- create this with
          quantity = quantity - splitQuantity
        return SplitResult with
          splitAsset
          remainder

    choice Merge
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        otherCid : ContractId Asset
      controller owner
      do
        other <- fetch otherCid
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: issuer does not match"
          (issuer == other.issuer)
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: owner does not match"
          (owner == other.owner)
        assertMsg
          "Merge failed: symbol does not match"
          (symbol == other.symbol)
        archive otherCid
        create this with
          quantity = quantity + other.quantity
-- MERGE_SPLIT_END

    choice ProposeTransfer
      : ContractId TransferProposal
      with
        newOwner : Party
      controller owner
      do
        create TransferProposal with
          asset = this
          newOwner

    choice  SetObservers
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        newObservers : [Party]
      controller owner
      do
        create this with
          observers = newObservers

template TransferProposal
  with
    asset : Asset
    newOwner : Party
  where
    signatory (signatory asset)
    observer newOwner

    choice TransferProposal_Accept
        : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.issuer, newOwner
        do
          create asset with
            owner = newOwner

    choice TransferProposal_Cancel
        : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.owner
        do
          create asset with
            observers = []

    choice TransferProposal_Reject
        : ContractId Asset
        controller newOwner
        do
          create asset

template TransferApproval
  with
    asset : Asset
    newOwner : Party
  where
    signatory asset.issuer
    observer asset.owner, newOwner

    choice TransferApproval_Cancel
        : ()
        controller asset.owner
        do
          return ()

    choice TransferApproval_Reject
        : ()
        controller newOwner
        do
          return ()

    choice TransferApproval_Transfer
        : ContractId Asset
        with
          assetCid : ContractId Asset
        controller asset.owner, newOwner
        do
          sentAsset <- fetch assetCid
          assertMsg
            "Transfer failed: Assets do not match."
            (asset == sentAsset with
              observers = asset.observers
            )
          archive assetCid
          create asset with
            owner = newOwner
            observers = []
-- Copyright (c) 2025 Digital Asset (Switzerland) GmbH and/or its affiliates. All rights reserved.
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

-- PRAGMA_BEGIN

module Intro.Asset.Role where
-- PRAGMA_END


-- IMPORT_BEGIN
import Intro.Asset
-- IMPORT_END

template AssetHolderInvite
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
  where
    signatory issuer
    observer owner

    choice AssetHolderInvite_Accept
      : ContractId AssetHolder
      controller owner
      do
        create AssetHolder with
          issuer
          owner

template AssetHolder
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
  where
    signatory issuer, owner

    nonconsuming choice Issue_Asset
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        symbol : Text
        quantity : Decimal
      controller issuer
      do
        create Asset with
          issuer
          owner
          symbol
          quantity
          observers = []

    nonconsuming choice Accept_Transfer
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        transferProposalCid : ContractId TransferProposal
      controller owner
      do
        exercise transferProposalCid TransferProposal_Accept

    nonconsuming choice Preapprove_Transfer
      : ContractId TransferApproval
      with
        asset : Asset
      controller owner
      do
        create TransferApproval with
          asset
          newOwner = owner

+  usdApproval2 <- submit bob do

item.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/(_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, rejectedTradeCid) <- setupMultiTrade/(_, secondBob, _, _, _, _, _, _, rejectedTradeCid) <- setupMultiTrade/; s/submit bob do exerciseCmd rejectedTradeCid Trade_Reject/submit secondBob do exerciseCmd rejectedTradeCid Trade_Reject/; s/None <- queryContractId bob rejectedTradeCid/None <- queryContractId secondBob rejectedTradeCid/' daml/Intro/Asset/MultiTradeTests.daml
cat >> daml/Intro/Asset/MultiTradeTests.daml <<'EOF'

test_settle_rejects_misdescribed_base = do
  (alice, bob, baseCids, baseAssets, quoteCids, quoteAssets, baseApprovals, quoteApprovals, _) <- setupMultiTrade
  badTradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd MultiTrade with
      baseAssetCids = baseCids
      baseAssets = [head baseAssets with quantity = 101.0, head (tail baseAssets)]
      quoteApprovalCids = quoteApprovals
      quoteAssets = quoteAssets
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd badTradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCids = quoteCids
      baseApprovalCids = baseApprovals

test_settle_rejects_misdescribed_quote = do
  (alice, bob, baseCids, baseAssets, quoteCids, quoteAssets, baseApprovals, quoteApprovals, _) <- setupMultiTrade
  badTradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd MultiTrade with
      baseAssetCids = baseCids
      baseAssets = baseAssets
      quoteApprovalCids = quoteApprovals
      quoteAssets = [head quoteAssets with quantity = 91.0, head (tail quoteAssets)]
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd badTradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCids = quoteCids
      baseApprovalCids = baseApprovals

test_settle_single_asset_each_side = do
  (alice, bob, baseCids, baseAssets, quoteCids, quoteAssets, baseApprovals, quoteApprovals, _) <- setupMultiTrade
  singleCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd MultiTrade with
      baseAssetCids = [head baseCids]
      baseAssets = [head baseAssets]
      quoteApprovalCids = [head quoteApprovals]
      quoteAssets = [head quoteAssets]
  (newBaseCids, newQuoteCids) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd singleCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCids = [head quoteCids]
      baseApprovalCids = [head baseApprovals]
  assert (length newBaseCids == 1)
  assert (length newQuoteCids == 1)
  Some transferredBase <- queryContractId bob (head newBaseCids)
  Some transferredQuote <- queryContractId alice (head newQuoteCids)
  assert (transferredBase == head baseAssets with owner = bob; observers = [])
  assert (transferredQuote == head quoteAssets with owner = alice; observers = [])
EOF
daml test > /tmp/multi-trade-test-result.log 2>&1; status="'$?; tail -55 /tmp/multi-trade-test-result.log; exit "$status"'

test_settle_rejects_wrong_quote_approvals = do
  (alice, bob, baseCids, baseAssets, quoteCids, quoteAssets, baseApprovals, quoteApprovals, _) <- setupMultiTrade

    createCmd MultiTrade with
      baseAssetCids = baseCids
      baseAssets = baseAssets
      quoteApprovalCids = reverse quoteApprovals
      quoteAssets = quoteAssets
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd badTradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCids = quoteCids
      baseApprovalCids = baseApprovals

test_settle_allows_changed_quote_observers = do
  (alice, bob, _, _, quoteCids, quoteAssets, baseApprovals, _, tradeCid) <- setupMultiTrade
  observedQuoteCid <- submit bob do
